req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-035 requires that after deleting every task, GET /tasks/ returns an empty list []. The test suite covers: (1) positive path — delete all 20 pre-loaded tasks one by one and verify GET /tasks/ returns exactly []; (2) negative path — attempt to delete a non-existent task ID and verify HTTP 404 with correct detail; (3) boundary path — delete the last remaining task (count transitions from 1 to 0) and verify the empty-list invariant; (4) state-transition — verify intermediate state (non-empty) before final empty state; (5) decision-table — verify that deleting a completed task and an incomplete task both succeed with 204. Each test uses an in-memory SQLite override so the pre-loaded fixture is isolated per test.

tests.name: test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with IDs 1-20
GET /tasks/ returns a non-empty list before deletions
actions: DELETE each task by its ID
expected: Final GET /tasks/ returns HTTP 200 with body exactly []
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

engine_t = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r035_pos.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionLocal_t = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_t)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_t)

TASKS = [
    {"title": "Read chapter 5", "description": "desc", "completed": True},
    {"title": "Book flight tickets", "description": "desc", "completed": True},
    {"title": "Submit expense report", "description": "desc", "completed": True},
    {"title": "Prepare meeting agenda", "description": "desc", "completed": False},
    {"title": "Write project report", "description": "desc", "completed": False},
]

db_s = SessionLocal_t()
for t in TASKS:
    db_s.add(models.Task(title=t["title"], description=t["description"], completed=t["completed"]))
db_s.commit()
db_s.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionLocal_t()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list():
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    tasks = r.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 5
    for task in tasks:
        rd = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task['id']}")
        assert rd.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json() == []

test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine_t)
import os; os.remove("./test_r035_pos.db") if os.path.exists("./test_r035_pos.db") else None

from app.main import app

def test_intermediate_state_nonempty_then_empty_after_all_deleted():
    r0 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    tasks = r0.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 3
    rd1 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{tasks[0]['id']}")
    assert rd1.status_code == 204
    r1 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert len(r1.json()) == 2

    assert rd2.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert len(r2.json()) == 1
    rd3 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{tasks[2]['id']}")
    assert rd3.status_code == 204
    r3 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r3.status_code == 200
    assert r3.json() == []
